articles.summary: Building new transmission is essential to meeting growing power needs in many parts of the country, particularly in areas like Virginia where there are many data center clusters. MYR Group subsidiary The L.E. Myers Co (L.E. Myers) supported that growth as the prime contractor for the Chase City to Cloud transmission project for Dominion Energy.
